title: fix(console): localize the organization-limit refusal in the create-workspace dialog
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPFXdEVvapaU7V47g3TwNSXj)_
Closes #28124

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台「新建组织」对话框遇到组织数上限的拒绝（403 `YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS`）时，改为显示当前语言的说明文案，全部 11 个语言包都加了这条。
- 为什么改：cloud 把每人可建组织数降到 2 之后，用户建第 3 个组织时看到的是 better-auth 的英文原句，中文用户看不懂，也不知道被邀请加入的组织不算在内。
- 风险与回滚：只加了一行错误码映射和一个文案键，不碰服务端；回滚就是撤掉这个 PR。文案不写具体数字，因为拒绝响应体和 `/auth/config` 都不带上限值。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/orgErrorMessage.ts`（新增的映射行和注释）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh-Hans.ts`（中文文案）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx`（末尾新增的 zh/en 用例）。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `npx vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx`，应全绿，其中 zh-Hans 用例显示「您创建的组织数量已达上限。被邀请加入的组织不计入此上限。」
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `orgErrorMessage.ts`: `ORG_ERROR_MESSAGE_KEYS` gains a row for better-auth's `YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS`, mapped to the new key `organization.errors.organizationLimitReached`, with an English `defaultValue`. The header docblock lists the code among the create-path rows.
- All 11 console packs (`en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `ar`) define the key. `zh-Hant` is regenerated from `zh-Hans` with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n gen:zh-hant`, not hand-written.
- The sentence says the cap counts only organizations the user created, never ones they were invited to. That is the part a refused user cannot guess, and it is how the server counts (`role = owner` rows in `sys_member`).
- Changeset: `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, patch.

## Why

The hosted control plane caps self-created organizations at 2 (`OS_ORG_LIMIT`, better-auth `organizationLimit`). A third create is refused with 403 and the code above. The console had no row for that code, so `resolveOrgErrorMessage` fell through to the server's English sentence in every locale.

Work item 2 (name the number only if it is exposed), measured on objectstack `9728ab15` and cloud `ac69aac`:

- The refusal is thrown at `better-auth@1.7.12` `dist/plugins/organization/routes/crud-org.mjs:61` as `APIError.from("FORBIDDEN", ORGANIZATION_ERROR_CODES.YOU_HAVE_REACHED_THE_MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_ORGANIZATIONS)`. The body is the bare code and message, with no limit in it.
- The limit is read inside the `organizationLimit` callback (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts:204`, `resolveOrgLimit()` at `packages/types/src/env.ts:727`) and returned as a boolean. The `/auth/config` `features` object (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:5047` onward) does not publish it.
- cloud sets the value in the container env only (`apps/cloud/cloudflare/worker.ts:503`, `OS_ORG_LIMIT: '2'`). Nothing in cloud adds it to a response.

So the message names no number, and a test holds every pack to that.

## Tests

- `orgErrorMessage-4474.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` for the code: zh renders the zh pack value (Han script, not the server sentence); en renders the en pack value; every pack defines the key, its own sentence differs from `en`, and no pack value contains a digit. The exact-set pin of mapped codes gains the code.
- `CreateWorkspaceDialog.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe`: through the real `zh-Hans` and `en` packs, a create refused with the limit code shows the pack sentence in `workspace-create-error`, not the server's English, and the dialog neither retries nor provisions.

Ablation (one-off, no permanent file), with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` renaming the mapping row's key so the code is unmapped: anchor x1 to x0, blob `335e7a7e` to `2050edb8`. 5 tests went red (zh and en in each file, plus the exact-set pin), 33 stayed green. Restore: blob equals HEAD `335e7a7e`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- No spec change, no server change.
- `zh-Hant` is a generated catalogue (`zh-hant-generated.test.ts`), so its sentence is the converter's rendering of the zh-Hans one.
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` lists the new key as `needs-review`, exactly like its nine siblings in `organization.errors`: the gate cannot read a key held as a value in a mapping table. It is a report, not a red.
- `Type Check UI` for `@object-ui/app-shell` is left to CI: a local `type-check` needs every `@object-ui/*` workspace package built first.

## Verification

Local readings, on objectstack-ai/objectstack:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on head `0ad95797`: 38 derived families, every one run on that head and exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero, every row carries its exit code).
- i18n gates under `ui/`: `pnpm check:i18n-drift` exit 0 (0 en values changed, 1 key added), `pnpm check:i18n-keys` exit 0, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` exit 0 (report; see the acceptance note).
- `npx vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/` under `ui/`, on `b1443871`'s tree (the last code commit; `0ad95797` adds only the changeset): 116/116 files, 1967 passed, 13 skipped. This covers `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts`, `en-zh-key-parity.test.ts` and `zh-hant-generated.test.ts`.
- Ablation: see Tests.

CI runs every other family on the PR.

## Eager en catalogue ceiling (round 2, head f6ba31c0)

The merge queue (run 42468749097, Build & E2E UI) failed `check:eager-closure`: `i18n-locale-en` over its 60,000-byte ceiling. Measured on one tree, `main` at `eb92a48d` merged into this branch (`505ceb64`), with `CI=true pnpm exec vite build` in `ui/apps/console` reading `dist/eager-closure.json`: 59,981 gzipped bytes with this PR's one `en` line deleted, 60,036 with it. So `main` was 19 bytes under the line and the new key costs 55.

Fix (b): `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS['i18n-locale-en']` 60,000 to 61,000, with `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE['i18n-locale-en']` moved by the same 1,000 (40,415 to 41,415), keeping the gap. What the bytes buy: 55 for this explanation; the other 945 are shared headroom for the next few error strings of this size (about seventeen), not a budget for a new group. Option (a) did not apply: the organizations pages sit in no lazy i18n frame today, and `resolveOrgErrorMessage` is shared by the create dialog, the invite dialog and the accept-invitation page. Moving the whole `organization.*` group into a lazy namespace, as `marketplace` went (objectstack#30588), is the class fix and a card of its own. Not moved: the aggregate ceiling, `BASELINE`, `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES`, other rows.

On `f6ba31c0`: `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure` exit 0 (`i18n-locale-en` headroom 964 bytes; closure 2,237,137 bytes, headroom 246.9 KB); `scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts` 174/174; `packages/i18n/` + `organizations/` + that test 117 files, 2141 passed, 13 skipped; i18n drift/keys/dead-keys exit 0; dispatch-gates 38 derived, 38 run, each exit 0.
